text: The Slovenian landscape is generally very **hilly and forested**, with occasional agriculture.
_For exceptions to this, see the region guessing section._
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞的地貌通常非常**多山且森林密布**，偶有農田。
_關於此規則的例外，請參見地區猜測章節。_

text: A very significant portion of the coverage in Slovenia was taken on small roads deep **inside forest**.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞很大一部分的街景拍攝於**森林內部**的小路。

text: Slovenian architecture takes much inspiration from alpine architecture, with light coloured walls, **dark wooden details** and semi-steep roofs. The most common roof shape is [half-](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof#Half-hip_roof)[h](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof#Half-hip_roof)[ipped roofs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof#Half-hip_roof).
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞建築深受阿爾卑斯山建築風格啟發，擁有淺色牆面、**深色木質細節**以及微陡的屋頂。最常見的屋頂形狀是[半](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof#Half-hip_roof)[歇山](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof#Half-hip_roof)[頂](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof#Half-hip_roof)。

text: Slovene is a **Slavic language** featuring the special letters Č, Š, and Ž. It is closely related to Croatian, Serbian and Montenegrin.
NOTE: On top of having the same letters as Slovene, Croatian also has the letters Ć and Đ.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞語是一種**斯拉夫語言**，具有 Č、Š 和 Ž 等特殊字母。它與克羅埃西亞語、塞爾維亞語和蒙特內哥羅語高度相關。
註：除了擁有和斯洛維尼亞語相同的字母外，克羅埃西亞語還擁有 Ć 和 Đ 字母。

text: Slovenian bollards are white with a black top. The front reflector will typically be **bright red**, while the back reflector will be **white**.

NOTE: [Austrian](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.935857,15.6009415,3a,20.6y,357.69h,65.73t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sak-sxymIs2V63Wt8uwtlKA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) bollards have the same design, but with a dark red front reflector and a black or grey back reflector. [Montenegrin](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VKcVBeDadPfdZEwQ9) bollards also have a very similar design, also with a red and a white reflector.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞的路樁為白色配黑色頂部。前方的反光片通常為**亮紅色**，後方的反光片則為**白色**。

註：[奧地利](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.935857,15.6009415,3a,20.6y,357.69h,65.73t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sak-sxymIs2V63Wt8uwtlKA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)路樁設計相同，但前方反光片為暗紅色，後方反光片為黑色或灰色。[蒙特內哥羅](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VKcVBeDadPfdZEwQ9)的路樁設計也非常相似，同樣配有紅色和白色反光片。

text: Slovenian directional signs are **yellow** with a **black border**.

NOTE: Croatia, North Macedonia, Serbia and Montenegro all have similar directional signs. [Austrian](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.5568458,13.9585166,3a,17.9y,222.77h,88.58t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sgiePX811VzIqDTkzzrcHsw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) directional signs are typically white with a blue outline.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞的指示標誌為**黃色**配有**黑色邊框**。

註：克羅埃西亞、北馬其頓、塞爾維亞和蒙特內哥羅都有類似的指示標誌。[奧地利](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.5568458,13.9585166,3a,17.9y,222.77h,88.58t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sgiePX811VzIqDTkzzrcHsw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)的指示標誌通常為白色配藍色外框。

text: Slovenian kilometre markers have a very distinct design. At the top left the road number is shown in a **yellow rectangle**, and a second number is to the right of it. A horizontal black line divides the top and bottom, and the distance is shown below.
NOTE: [Austrian](https://goo.gl/maps/jtRvnb9JCZBuW8iLA) kilometre markers are blue with a white number.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞的里程碑設計非常獨特。左上方以**黃色長方形**顯示道路編號，右側則顯示另一個數字。上方與下方以一條水平黑線隔開，下方則顯示距離。
註：[奧地利](https://goo.gl/maps/jtRvnb9JCZBuW8iLA)的里程碑為藍色配白色數字。

text: Slovenian chevrons usually have **red arrows** on a **white background**.
You can also find a less common [version](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3rjSbRq9SMVina6a7) with a **black arrow** on a **white background**.
NOTE: [Austrian](https://goo.gl/maps/BM8aPY3HC9ox4UNHA) chevrons are either white on red or red on yellow.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞的轉彎標誌通常在**白色背景**上配有**紅色箭頭**。
你也可以找到較少見的[版本](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3rjSbRq9SMVina6a7)，其在**白色背景**上配有**黑色箭頭**。
註：[奧地利](https://goo.gl/maps/BM8aPY3HC9ox4UNHA)的轉彎標誌為白底紅字或黃底紅字。

text: Slovenian pedestrian signs have **five stripes** and a simply drawn person without a belt.
NOTE: [Austrian](https://goo.gl/maps/S3nXofrbfKot9eLD6) pedestrian signs have two dotted lines, while the person on [Croatian](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yy9Gf53S8AH7Areg6) signs has a belt.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞的行人標誌有**五條條紋**，且人物繪製簡單、沒有繫皮帶。
註：[奧地利](https://goo.gl/maps/S3nXofrbfKot9eLD6)的行人標誌有兩條虛線，而[克羅埃西亞](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yy9Gf53S8AH7Areg6)標誌上的人物則有繫皮帶。

text: Slovenian roads commonly feature **long outer dashes**.
NOTE: Neighbouring countries do not frequently use dashed outside lines.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞的道路通常具有**長的外側虛線**。
註：鄰國不常使用外側虛線。

text: Slovenian street signs are most commonly white with a **metal border** attached to signposts, or **red** and attached to house walls.

NOTE: [Czech](https://goo.gl/maps/gi5f8C9LNAUumAQFA) street signs are also typically red and attached to walls. However, Czech street names will not contain the word “ulica”, which most Slovenian street names have.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞的街道標誌通常為白色、帶有固定在柱子上的**金屬邊框**，或是**紅色**並固定在房屋牆壁上。
註：[捷克](https://goo.gl/maps/gi5f8C9LNAUumAQFA)的街道標誌通常也是紅色並固定在牆上。然而，捷克的街道名稱不會包含多數斯洛維尼亞街道名稱中會有的「ulica」一詞。

text: Slovenian house numbers are typically **red** with white text.
NOTE: [Czech](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.7257121,15.1788819,3a,15y,1.15h,98.69t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s4rpA0yUvp4TJif4QGtcHvQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) house numbers are also commonly red.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞的門牌號碼通常為**紅色**配白色文字。
註：[捷克](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.7257121,15.1788819,3a,15y,1.15h,98.69t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s4rpA0yUvp4TJif4QGtcHvQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)的門牌號碼通常也是紅色。

text: Slovenia uses a regular A-type guardrail, like most European countries. This guardrail type has **rounded edges**.
This is mostly useful for 50-50s with Croatia, which uses B-type guardrails. This type has square edges.
NOTE: For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/slovenia/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞使用一般的 A 型護欄，就像多數歐洲國家一樣。這種護欄類型具有**圓潤邊緣**。
這對於與使用 B 型護欄的克羅埃西亞進行二選一猜測時非常有用。B 型護欄具有方正的邊緣。
註：若要好好瀏覽歐洲護欄，請參見[此資訊圖表](/images/slovenia/europeguardrail.png)。

text: This type of shed, called a [kozolec](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hayrack), made of thin **wooden beams** with noticeable gaps in between, is very typical for Slovenia.
text_zh: 這種由細**木樑**組成且之間有明顯間隙的穀倉，稱為 [kozolec](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hayrack)（傳統乾草架），是斯洛維尼亞的典型特色。

text: A black generation 4 car can be found in Slovenia.
NOTE: A black car can be found in many European countries.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞可以找到黑色的第四代 Google 車。
註：許多歐洲國家都能找到黑色的 Google 車。

text: A white generation 4 Google car can also rarely be found in Slovenia.
NOTE: It can also be found in other European countries.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞也偶爾能找到白色的第四代 Google 車。
注意：這也可以在其他歐洲國家找到。

text: The tallest mountains in the country can be found in the northwestern **alpine** region.
text_zh: 國內最高的高山位於西北部的**阿爾卑斯**地區。

text: **Flat**, or rolling, agricultural fields with **no mountains or tall hills** in view can be seen in the east of the country.
text_zh: 國家的東部可以看到**平坦**或起伏的農田，且視野中**沒有山脈或高山丘**。

text: Near the coast you get a landscape similar to the rest of the Adriatic coast; **white cliffs** with bushy vegetation, vineyards and Mediterranean architecture.
text_zh: 靠近海岸處，你會看到類似亞得里亞海其他地區的景緻；帶有灌木植被、葡萄園和地中海式建築的**白色懸崖**。

text: A **wide valley** going east to west, with mountains to the north and south can be found in the southeast.
text_zh: 東至西走向的**寬闊山谷**，其南北兩側皆有山脈，可以在東南部找到。

text: **Italian bilingual signs** can be found in the westernmost region.
text_zh: 最西部地區可以找到**義大利語雙語標誌**。

text: Instead of the normal red house numbers, Ljubljana will typically feature **green house numbers**.
NOTE: [Street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/h5GSwk121qRJantj8) in Ljubljana are also occasionally green.
text_zh: 盧比安納通常會使用**綠色門牌號碼**，而不是一般的紅色門牌號碼。
註：盧比安納的[街道標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/h5GSwk121qRJantj8)偶爾也是綠色的。

text: Street signs in Celje feature the emblem of the city, a blue shield with **three yellow stars**.
text_zh: 采列的街道標誌帶有該市的徽章，即一個繪有**三顆黃色星星**的藍色盾牌。

text: Similar to Celje, Trbovlje also features the city’s coat of arms, which is a **blue and green** shield with a black crest.
text_zh: 與采列相似，特爾博夫列也有該市的城徽，是一個帶有黑色飾章的**藍綠色**盾牌。
